'''Edmond Nicolas Laguerre''' (9 April 1834, [[Bar-le-Duc]] – 14 August 1886, Bar-le-Duc) was a French [[mathematician]]<ref>{{cite book|chapter='''LAGUERRE''', Edmond Nicolas |title=The New International Encyclopaedia|edition=2nd|year=1918|volume= 13 |pages=468–469 |chapter-url=https://books.google.com/books?id=fmwNAQAAMAAJ&pg=PA468|last1=Colby|first1=Frank Moore|last2=Williams|first2=Talcott}}</ref> and a member of the [[Académie des sciences]] (1885). His main works were in the areas of [[geometry]] and [[complex analysis]]. He also investigated [[orthogonal polynomials]] (see [[Laguerre polynomials]]). [[Laguerre's method]] is a [[root-finding algorithm]] tailored to [[polynomial]]s. He laid the foundations of a geometry of oriented spheres (Laguerre geometry and [[Laguerre plane]]), including the [[Laguerre transformation]] or [[Spherical wave transformation#Transformation by reciprocal directions|transformation by reciprocal directions]].

*{{Cite journal|author=Laguerre, Edmond|year=1881|title=[[s:fr:Sur la transformation par directions réciproques|Sur la transformation par directions réciproques]]|journal=Comptes rendus|volume=92|pages=71–73}}
*{{Cite journal|author=Laguerre, Edmond|year=1882|title=[[s:fr:Transformations par semi-droites réciproques|Transformations par semi-droites réciproques]]|journal=[[Nouvelles Annales de Mathématiques|Nouvelles annales de mathématiques]]|volume=1|pages=542–556}}
* ''[https://books.google.com/books?id=j5IKAAAAYAAJ&pg=PP13 Théorie des équations numériques]'', Paris: Gauthier-Villars. 1884 on [[Google Books]]
* {{cite book|title=Recherches sur la géométrie de direction; méthodes de transformation; anticaustiques|publisher=Gauthier-Villars|year=1885|url=http://catalog.hathitrust.org/Record/009376052}}
